# Leon — Creative Developer

> Creative developer building modern web experiences, interactive tools, and scalable game systems. Specializing in React, Tailwind CSS, Python, Luau, and Roblox development.

## About
Leon is a software engineer and creative developer focused on high-performance web applications, clean minimal user interfaces, and automated scripting clients.

## Key Projects & Highlights
- **Roblox Playground**: Interactive in-browser Luau execution environment and physics simulator sandbox.
- **Discord Automation & Bots**: Custom 24/7 Rich Presence and webhook automation clients built with TypeScript/Node.js.
- **Web Applications**: Sleek, accessible React & Vite web experiences.

## Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: React, JavaScript (ESNext), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite
- **Backend & Scripting**: Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Luau (Roblox API), REST APIs
- **Tools & Utilities**: Git, Linux, EmailJS, Physics Simulation
